tree.description: Royal Farmers Collective — multi-division food manufacturing enterprise (NL). Divisions: FritoMaxx (frozen fries), KnappertjesBV (crisps), DeBietenBende (beet sugar), Vlokkenheim (potato flakes), Wortelkracht (chicory inulin), plus GroupServices (corporate IT). ISA-95: enterprise > businessUnit > site > area > workCenter > workUnit. S88 semantics inside production areas: process cells > units > equipment modules. Clean IT/OT split per site: production+utilities are OT; quality, maintenance (CMMS), logistics, erp and site-kpis are IT.
